parties: IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited; Wholly Owned Subsidiary (UAE)
headline: IRIS RegTech Solutions incorporates wholly owned subsidiary in UAE
sum: IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary (WOS) in the UAE, signalling geographic expansion of its regulatory technology and compliance platform into Middle Eastern markets.
implication: WOS incorporation in UAE triggers foreign direct investment compliance under Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) and Consolidated FDI Policy; confirms India-domiciled RegTech firm pursuing offshore jurisdiction strategy for regional regulatory arbitrage and client service delivery.
detail: IRIS RegTech, a Bengaluru-based regulatory technology and compliance software firm, has formally incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates. This move represents a material corporate action requiring disclosure to the stock exchange under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Rules. The WOS structure allows the parent entity to maintain 100% control while establishing a separate legal entity in UAE jurisdiction, typically used for regional market entry, data residency compliance, and localised client operations in the Middle East region.
